# Regenerative Farming Philippines

> A farming family from Calamba, Laguna, teaching the regenerative farming
> method for tropical farms: soil health, compost and biofertilizers, cover
> cropping, natural pest management, and season-aware planning. The family farm
> is Viking Farms PH, three generations on the same land.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/): the regenerative method, taught by a farming family.
- [The Method (all ten modules)](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/method/): the complete curriculum, module by module.
- [What is regenerative agriculture](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/method/why/): the working definition, principles, and how it differs from organic and permaculture.
- [The course](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/the-method/): the ten-module self-paced course.
- [Our story](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/our-story/): three generations on the same land in Calamba, Laguna.
